text:
Maria: Quick pulse before we freeze for the sprint release — folks please confirm one-liners for your ownerships. target cutoff in ~6h. I tried to keep this short, just bump/changelog/qa/security/docs sign-offs.

Ryan: On it. I have the minor change for the routing cache; planning to bump to v1.14.0.

Olivia: I can take docs — will do a quick changelog blurb and update the upgrade notes. Ping me when the final diff lands.

Sam: QA: smoke and perf run queued. ETA ~45m. If anyone expects new flaky tests, call now.

Release Bot: automated note: branch freeze scheduled at <3940127056> — CI will block merges 10m before cutoff. :robot_face:

Maria: Ryan — what's your exact bump command so docs match? Also confirm no DB migrations.

Ryan: No migrations. Command I used locally: `./scripts/bump_version.sh 1.14.0` then `git push origin release/v1.14.0`

Olivia: Changelog stub (will refine):
```
### v1.14.0 - 2026-03-17
- routing: reduce cache TTL for bursty workloads (Sam)
- infra: minor build cache improvements (Ryan)
- docs: upgrade notes for pinned model versions (Olivia)
```

Maria: Nice. Security Bot — any outstanding security review flags for this release?

Security Bot: quick scan done. One advisory flagged (low risk): dependency `compressor-js` needs patching in 1.2.3 -> 1.2.4. Recommend backport to patch branch or add override in lockfile.

Sam: I can do a quick verification after QA run. If we patch lockfile, give me the commit hash and I'll run smoke again.

Ryan: I'll add the lockfile override, push to `release/v1.14.0-patch`. Nothing else in code relies on that lib.

Olivia: Docs: will add a short note under "Security & dependencies" about the override and the reason.

Maria: Owners roll-call: Ryan (runtime), Sam (QA), Olivia (docs), Maria (cutover/runbook). If anyone wants to swap, say now.

Ryan: Confirmed.

Sam: Confirmed. I'll post smoke artifacts to the release channel.

Release Bot: canary deployment scheduled after merge (canary window 30m) — owners: Ryan, Sam.

Maria: Can we get a quick checklist in this thread so on-call has the minimal runbook? One-liners only.

Olivia: Docs: update changelog + upgrade note, link to runbook. (done after merge)

Ryan: Bump PR open: https://git.company/repo/pull/4822 — includes lockfile override.

Sam: QA checklist: 1) run smoke (all green) 2) perf sanity (<10% regression) 3) basic e2e on staging 4) signoff in PR comments. I'll tick each and paste results.

Security Bot: recommended action: backport lockfile bump to `release/v1.13.x` only if customer-facing vulnerability triggers; otherwise document override until next dependency update.

Maria: Good call. If QA passes, I'll merge and trigger the automated canary. Sam — if canary fails, what's our rollback plan?

Sam: Rollback plan: 1) abort canary and revert merge 2) redeploy previous tag 3) open hotfix PR if needed. I can lead the revert.

Olivia: Docs follow-up: will add quick internal note for support about the dependency override and expected impact (none).

Ryan: Merged lockfile override to `release/v1.14.0-patch`, CI passing.

Sam: Smoke results: ✅ all smoke checks passed. Perf: 3% median token latency improvement. E2E: one intermittent failing spec (chat-attachments) — investigating, likely unrelated flaky.

Maria: Since smoke + perf good, and flaky test likely unrelated, I'm going to proceed with merge to release branch. If Sam confirms e2e later, we'll promote.

Release Bot: merge to `release/v1.14.0` recorded by @Maria at 3940123460. Canary deploy started.

Sam: Canary after 10m: all metrics stable. No error spike. Approving full rollout.

Security Bot: note logged: dependency override recorded in release notes and security tracker ticket #SEC-512.

Olivia: Changelog published and internal support note sent.

Maria: Thanks everyone — release rolled. Closing thread after the postmortem checklist tomorrow. :tada: 

-- end of thread --
